features: DATABASE CHANGES: TWENTY-FOUR MIGRATIONS AND SIX SETTINGS MIGRATIONS, NONE OF THEM CHANGES THE DATA YOU ALREADY HAVE — The update runs twenty-four new migrations and six settings migrations by itself. Twenty-seven new tables: the change log (the rows, the condominiums and people of each row, the chain of fingerprints); the previous versions of replaced documents; the meetings, with their sittings, the agenda items and the records they are about, the people convened, the means chosen for a single meeting and the budget frozen for the meeting; the resolutions, with their links to the records and the things to do afterwards; the «Da portare in assemblea» (to bring to the meeting) memo; the meeting room (proxies, attendance, votes, single votes, statements for the minutes, actions); the minutes (the minutes book, the minutes with their text and versions, the register of appointments and dismissals). New columns on existing tables: the general ownership table of the condominium, of the building and of the staircase; on the person's record how he or she is convened and the day he or she gave the PEC address; in the sending log the outcome, its day and the day that counts for the notice of meeting; in the settings of each condominium how heads are counted in the room for someone who owns one unit alone and another in co-ownership (by default «due teste», two heads); on the instalment plan the day of the urgent works; the author of a calendar event becomes optional, for what the program creates by itself. No migration fills in or changes the data you already have: the new columns start empty, and only one writes a row, the one the change log chain starts from. The new settings, with their default value: how long the change log is kept (10 years), the studio's postal days (3), the studio's PEC mailbox (empty, port 465 with SSL), the last mail test (empty: mail already set up shows «Da provare», to be tested), the proxy beyond one fifth (refused) and the co-owners' split vote (abstained), the email reminder of notices still to be sent (on). Five new permissions: «Vede il registro delle modifiche» (sees the change log), «Vede la storia delle schede» (sees the history of records), «Vede le assemblee» (sees meetings), «Gestisce le assemblee» (manages meetings), «Registra il verbale sottoscritto» (records the signed minutes); the update realigns the default roles by itself: the administrator has them all, the collaborator sees the history of records and sees and manages meetings. The server requirements do not change; the reminder of notices and the deletion of old change log rows run with the server's scheduler (the cron). After the update, reload the pages you already have open.

CHANGED: THE RESOLUTION IS CHOSEN, NOT TYPED — Where you used to type the day of a resolution (the instalment plan, the ratification of an expense over budget, invoices, the six-month waiver, the repayment agreement, the debt recovery rules, charges, funds, amounts already paid, transfers), whoever manages meetings finds «Scegli la delibera» (choose the resolution): at the top the resolution of the meeting that discussed it, with the reason, and below all the others of the condominium, by meeting. The day comes from the resolution and is the day of the meeting, also for ratification. A meeting held on paper is recorded from there with «Registra una delibera a mano» (record a resolution by hand): the day, ordinary or extraordinary, what was decided, the outcome and the minutes number; without the minutes file it stays «Verbale da caricare» (minutes to upload). Nothing is linked until you save the page. Whoever does not have the «Gestisce le assemblee» permission types the day as before. Dates already typed by hand stay: at the top of the meetings archive a row offers to collect them, with a preview that writes nothing; ratifications made before stay recorded and do not come back among the things to bring to the meeting.

CHANGED: LETTERS TO DEFAULTERS AND PEC — Reminders, formal notices and notices of default can also go out by PEC (certified email), from the studio's PEC mailbox: the letters window has the channels «PEC dello studio» (studio's PEC) and «PEC e carta» (PEC and paper: the same letter, with the same PDF, goes out by PEC and is printed); the friendly reminder stays by email, print or PDF. The person's PEC address is no longer one of the email addresses: whoever has only a PEC address receives the letter by PEC or printed, and the window says so. The program proposes the channel of the last letter; without letters, for the reminder the email, then the PEC address the person gave you, then print. PECs go out at most 50 at a time, with «Manda le altre» (send the others). You drag the provider's delivery receipt (the .eml file) onto the letter's row: the program reads the day and time, archives it, and the letter's deadline is counted from delivery. A PEC not sent or not delivered has «Manda di nuovo per PEC, con le cifre di oggi» (send again by PEC, with today's figures).

CHANGED: URGENCY IN INSTALMENT PLANS — In the new instalment plan the choice between «Delibera dell'assemblea» (meeting resolution) and «Urgenza (art. 1135 c.c.)» (urgency) is a single one, the same on both tabs, and urgency is also available on «Dalle voci del preventivo» (from the budget items) of an extraordinary management, where the resolution date used to be always required. With urgency you write the reason and «Lavori ordinati il …» (works ordered on …), today by default: the day of the works decides who pays, like the resolution for the other plans, and whoever was the owner that day pays the share of his or her unit in full, without splitting it by days. On the invoices tab with urgency the day of the works is now always required: invoices with their own period keep it, those without take the day of the works. The urgent plan is born approved, and its page says «Lavori ordinati il …» and «Da riferire alla prima assemblea di …» (to be reported to the first meeting of …): the item is already proposed when you prepare it. An invoice recorded later on the same item proposes «Lavori ordinati il …» as its accrual, which you can change.

CHANGED: CHARGING THE EXPENSE OF A WORK — In the charges window, for the expense of a work financed by several plans the proposed person is whoever was the owner at the resolution of the work's first plan (the one with the oldest resolution), the same rule as the per-person balance; before, the proposal could come from another plan. The expense is extraordinary when its management is, not the type of plan. With two different resolutions in the same financial year the window proposes no one and says so: you choose among the owners.

CHANGED: THE MENUS — The top menu of the management area has the «Assemblee» (meetings) entry; the entries sit on one line, and the link to the source code stays only at the bottom of every page. On the condominium dashboard the quick actions are in the «Azioni» (actions) menu, together with «Da portare in assemblea». In «Rate scadute» (overdue instalments) the actions of each row are in the «⋯» menu, as in the other tables. The condominium structure tabs sit on one line, with «Registro» (log).

CHANGED: THE RECEIPT AND STATEMENT SHEET WINDOWS — The window for sending receipts is anchored at the top, with three groups, the stamp duty choice on one line and the addresses as buttons that say how many people they reach; at the bottom there is a fixed summary («Partono 2 email a 1 persona, 1 ricevuta.», 2 emails to 1 person, 1 receipt), and whoever has no address is listed by name in a box with «Stampa la ricevuta per la posta» (print the receipt for the post). The single receipt window has the same form and is wider: «A che cosa va il versamento» (what the payment goes to) gives the criterion and a summary («€ 153,37 su 6 quote di 3 piani. Restano € 17,42.»), and the table of shares opens with «Mostra le quote» (show the shares). In the statement sheets window, with no addresses chosen it says «Nessun indirizzo scelto» (no address chosen), and whoever has no address is listed by name in a box.

NEW: THE CHANGE LOG — Who changed what and when, with the value before and after, across the whole program: the records of condominiums, people and suppliers, accounting (a posted entry also gives the amount), documents, users (invitation, role, suspension, deletion), the calendar and tasks when a person touches them, and commands run from the terminal, signed «Il programma» (the program). No one can modify or delete it, not even the administrator. It starts on the day of the update: earlier changes are not there. The condominium log is the «Registro» tab of the structure; the studio log is in the settings. Filters «Chi» (who), «Su che cosa» (on what), «Che cosa è successo» (what happened), «Periodo» (period) and «Cerca» (search), and pages of 20, 50 or 100 rows. «Storia» (history), on a row or in a record's header, opens the changes of that record, and «Ripristina» (restore) puts back the previous value of a field through the record's own checks; in accounting, instalment plans and thousandths there is no restore: you change it from the record, or reverse it. The «Registro» menu, next to «Guida» (guide), has «Verifica l'integrità» (check integrity), «Stampa» (print: a window with the period, which counts the rows before printing, at most 5,000 per PDF, with the fingerprint) and «Sospendi la cancellazione» (suspend deletion). The log and the print are seen by whoever has «Vede il registro delle modifiche», by default the administrator; the «Storia» also by the collaborator; condominium owners and suppliers never.

NEW: SIGNATURE, RETENTION AND REDACTION OF THE LOG — Every row is born with the program's signature, made with a key that lives on the server and not in the database, and carries the fingerprint of the previous one. «Verifica l'integrità» says «Il registro è integro.» (the log is intact) or «Una riga non torna.» (a row does not match), with the row changed, added or removed outside the program and the report to download; a row added by hand has the mark «Aggiunta fuori dal programma» (added outside the program). Whoever also has the server key can rewrite everything: the chain makes a change visible, it does not prevent it. Rows are kept 10 years by default (or 15, or 20, as the administrator chooses) and the oldest are removed at night; «Sospendi la cancellazione», with the reason (for example a pending lawsuit), stops deletion for the whole studio until you lift it. «Oscura i dati di … nel registro» (redact the data of … in the log), for the administrator only, answers an erasure request: the rows keep who, when and on what, and the person's data become «oscurato il …» (redacted on …); the redaction is itself a log row and cannot be undone. Restoring a backup does not remove the rows that came after: they stay, marked «Annullata dal ripristino del …» (cancelled by the restore of …).

NEW: PREVIOUS VERSIONS OF DOCUMENTS — A replaced document stays as a previous version, read-only, with the day, who replaced it, the size and the fingerprint, and can be downloaded from «Versioni di prima» (previous versions) on the document's edit page: in the condominium archive and in the documents of suppliers, units and people. Previous versions take up space like the other files.

NEW: MEETINGS — The «Assemblee» entry opens the condominium's meetings archive, by year, with the «Anno» (year) and «Stato» (status) filters. «Prepara l'assemblea» (prepare the meeting) prepares one in the program; «Registra una delibera a mano», in the «Azioni» menu, records a meeting held on paper. The meeting page is a path of six steps: «Date e ordine del giorno» (dates and agenda), «Documenti» (documents), «Convocazione» (notice of meeting), «In sala» (in the room), «Verbale e trasmissione» (minutes and sending), «Delibere eseguite» (resolutions carried out); below the path «Che cosa manca» (what is missing) says what is needed to go on, each with its button, and on the phone the path reads vertically. The «Diario» (diary), in the «Azioni» menu, says who did what on the meeting, sendings included. A meeting prepared here and held on paper is closed with «Tenuta su carta» (held on paper), which records the day and the outcomes from the paper minutes; a notice to redo is done with «Annulla e riconvoca» (cancel and reconvene), which creates a new meeting. The proposed days are Rome's days, even with the computer in another time zone.

NEW: DATES AND AGENDA — While you write the dates the program checks the second call (on another day, after the first, no more than ten days later: art. 1136 c. 3 c.c.) and, if the first call is too close for the five days of notice (art. 66 c. 3 disp. att.), says from which day there would be time by registered letter and by PEC or by hand: it does not block. Continuation dates are in the same notice. The default value table is the general ownership table, which you choose once for the condominium, the building or the staircase, also from «Prepara l'assemblea». The program proposes the items: the financial statement, the budget, any other business, your memos, the pending matters (an expense to ratify with its reason, a plan without resolution, the six-month waiver, a deficit to recover) and what the summary note brings to the meeting; what you remove stays for the next one. You write your own items already in «Prepara l'assemblea», and the arrows change their order. The majority is proposed from the subject, with the article: the subjects of the law with theirs (almost all half of the value), innovations and individual installations with two thirds; under the menu the rule is written in words. An item can concern a single staircase or building, with its table; for a change of intended use the item asks for the common parts and the new use (art. 1117-ter c.c.). With «Una frase per la bacheca» (a sentence for the notice board) you choose what everyone reads, tenants included.

NEW: THE «DA PORTARE IN ASSEMBLEA» MEMO — From an invoice, a plan, a fund, an agreement, a waiver, a rule, a fault report and the other records, «Da portare in assemblea» saves an item for the next meeting while you work; with «Ricordamelo» (remind me) and a day it also becomes an Action inbox task, for you, for the whole studio or for a collaborator. On the condominium dashboard the «Per la prossima assemblea» (for the next meeting) card lists the waiting items, each with its menu («Apri …», open; «Modifica», edit; «Non serve più», no longer needed), and «Aggiungi un punto» (add an item) writes a new one. A postponed item, even one you wrote by hand, goes back into the condominium's memory for the next meeting.

NEW: DOCUMENTS AND THE MEETING FILE — In the «Documenti» step you choose what each condominium owner receives with the notice: every item has «Aggiungi un documento» (add a document), with those proposed by the program, the condominium documents and a new PDF, which goes into the condominium documents in the «Assemblee» category, not published. The program adds nothing by itself and never proposes a person's documents. «Ferma il preventivo» (freeze the budget) freezes for the meeting the budget the owners receive; «Avanti: Convocazione» (next: notice) marks the step as done. «Componi il fascicolo» (build the file) makes a single PDF with the cover, the notice and the items' documents, and «Uno per persona (.zip)» (one per person) does it for each person, with the name and the proxy; the summary counts pages and size. The «Stato di esecuzione delle delibere precedenti» (status of previous resolutions) item carries the print the program makes from the list of resolutions, without names. The meeting prints follow the model of the other prints, with the studio and the condominium.

NEW: THE NOTICE OF MEETING, PERSON BY PERSON — Those convened are whoever appears in the registry on the day of sending: each co-owner gets his or her own notice; with a usufruct the notice goes to both when there is an extraordinary item; the tenant receives only the items where he or she votes or speaks. The means is one of those of art. 66 (PEC, registered letter, delivery by hand, fax; plain email is not valid as a notice): you choose it on the person's record, in «Come si convoca» (how to convene), or the program proposes it from the data; on the notice row you change it for a single meeting. «Entro quando spedire» (by when to send) gives the last day for the five days and proposes the day to send registered letters, counting prudently; «Come conto» (how I count) draws the week with the studio's postal days, Monday to Friday and without holidays. With the first call too close it proposes today, says from when there would be time and offers «Sposta le date» (move the dates): it does not block. «Stampa le lettere» (print the letters) makes the notices with the name, the units and the detachable proxy; «Manda le PEC» (send the PECs) sends them from the studio's PEC mailbox, each with the documents of its items; «Registra la spedizione» (record the sending) records the day the printed letters left. It is the first recorded sending, not the print, that convenes the meeting: from then on dates, items and documents no longer change. «Avviso anche in bacheca» (notice also on the board) opens the communication already written, with each item's notice board sentence. With an item on the intended use, the note gives the twenty days and the two posting dates.

NEW: PROOF OF THE NOTICE — «Registra la consegna» (record the delivery) writes what happened and the day: for a registered letter not collected the notice of storage counts; a refusal is recorded, but alone it is not valid as receipt. You drag the PEC delivery receipt (the provider's .eml file) onto the person's row, or choose it with «Carica la ricevuta PEC» (upload the PEC receipt): the program reads the day and time and archives it; if it is not that person's receipt, it says so and writes nothing. The same for the non-delivery notice. Deliveries by hand have their own sheet with the signature column, and the signed scan is valid for all the ticked people. A wrong outcome is corrected with the reason, and the proof stays. «Stampa la prova» (print the proof) gives for each person the means, the sending, the outcome and the day that counts.

NEW: THE STUDIO'S PEC MAILBOX — The «Configurazione email» (email configuration) page lists the studio's mailboxes: the mail and the PEC mailbox. The PEC mailbox is set up (address, server, port, encryption, user and password, which stays encrypted), tested, changed with «Modifica» and removed with «Togli la casella PEC» (remove the PEC mailbox). Notices of meeting and letters to defaulters use it: without the mailbox the PEC buttons are off and say where to set it up. Mail set up before the update shows «Da provare» (to be tested) until you test it: it is advice, it does not block anything.

NEW: MEETING TASKS AND REMINDER — The Action inbox has the meeting tasks: «Spedire la convocazione entro il …» (send the notice by …), which closes when all those convened have their notice sent; the new owner of a unit sold after the sending; the meeting still «in corso» (in progress) the next day; the two versions to choose from; the proxy or the opening to decide; the resolutions to carry out and those rejected. Whoever prepared the meeting receives an email two working days before the deadline and on the morning of that day, at 8:15, if notices are still to be sent; it is on by default and can be turned off in the mail settings. The server's scheduler is needed.

NEW: THE MEETING ROOM — The «In sala» step opens from the first recorded sending: before the day you record the proxies received, with the scan (the one-fifth limit is counted as you record them), and print the room sheet. «Apri la sala» (open the room) lights up on the day of the first call; before opening, the program says who does not appear convened, convened late or with the notice refused, and the chairman decides: «Rinvia l'assemblea» (postpone the meeting), or open with the reason. Chairman and secretary are chosen among the condominium owners; the secretary can be the administrator. The bar counts the owners and thousandths in the room and says what is needed at first and second call (art. 1136 c.c.). Each person is on one row, with «Entra» (enters), «Esce» (leaves) and, in the «⋯» menu, «In collegamento» (connected: for whoever takes part connected, it counts as in the room) and «Delega» (proxy); «Cerca per nome o per unità» (search by name or unit) finds whoever arrives. A person is one head even with several units; a co-owned unit votes through one representative, and the other co-owners enter «senza voto» (without vote); with a usufruct the usufructuary votes on ordinary matters and on the appointment of the administrator, the bare owner on the rest; the tenant votes only where the law lets him or her vote; whoever owns one unit alone and another in co-ownership counts as two heads by default, or one if the condominium chooses so. With more than twenty owners a proxy beyond one fifth is refused by default, with the article, or the chairman decides it; the administrator does not receive proxies. «Segna deserta» (mark as deserted) works for the first and the second call, also after the roll call, until a vote is held.

NEW: VOTING AND CLOSING — «Si vota» (vote now) freezes who is present: whoever enters later does not count for that vote. «Tutti i presenti favorevoli» (all present in favour) records them in one action, then you change those against and the abstentions; under the counts the outcome reads by condition, heads and value, with the threshold and how much is missing. «In conflitto» (in conflict) is recorded with the note, and the room says whether it was decisive. Without the quorum the vote still takes place and the chairman decides. The chairman writes a note on the vote and one on who did not vote; an owner's «Dichiarazione a verbale» (statement for the minutes) can be corrected or removed until the vote is confirmed. «Conferma» (confirm) writes the outcome and the resolution; «Un altro esito» (another outcome) asks for the reason; a confirmed vote is corrected with the reason. With more than six items you move between them with the arrows and a menu. «Sospendi, prosegue il …» (suspend, continues on …) proposes only the dates in the notice; «Chiudi l'assemblea» (close the meeting) postpones the items not dealt with, which come back for the next one; «Rinvia l'assemblea» prepares a new one, with a new notice. Once the meeting is closed, the room reads as it was, with outcome, counts, discussion, notes and statements, without buttons.

NEW: THE ROOM WITHOUT NETWORK AND ON PAPER — Each action in the room is first written to the browser's disk, then goes out by itself, in order, when the network is there: a row recorded without network has the mark «Su questo computer» (on this computer), and an item can be voted entirely without network. If two devices change the same thing nothing is overwritten: «Scegli» (choose) shows the two versions. If the computer switches off, the reopened room finds the actions not yet sent. Without network only the room and the minutes reopen, and only on a computer where they were already opened with the network; an https address is needed, and a private window keeps nothing (the program says so before opening). The work kept in the browser is deleted when the meeting is closed, postponed or deserted, and on logging out. On paper: the room sheet is printed the day before, with the proxies already written, or halfway with «Stampa il foglio con quello che c'è» (print the sheet with what is there); afterwards «Registra dal foglio della sala» (record from the room sheet) brings back the actions with the time written on the sheet. The «Le presenze e i voti» (attendance and votes) report has the lines for the chairman's and secretary's signatures.

NEW: MINUTES WRITTEN IN THE PROGRAM — Under the vote of each item the secretary writes «La discussione» (the discussion); the «Il verbale» (minutes) page also opens from another computer, and two people write two different items together (one person at a time writes the same part, with «Chiedi di scrivere», ask to write). Once the room is closed, «Genera il verbale dal modello» (generate the minutes from the template) composes the minutes with the room data and the discussions; templates are written in «Modelli delle lettere» (letter templates). Sentences with numbers are marked «Dati della sala» (room data), and if a figure does not match the votes a warning says so, with «Rimetti» (put back). The text saves itself a few seconds after you stop typing, and at least every 30 seconds; «Le versioni» (versions) keeps them all, with «Ripristina». Without network or with the computer off the text stays on the computer and goes out when the network is back. «Stampa la bozza da firmare» (print the draft to sign), then «Registra il verbale sottoscritto» (a scan, or the digitally signed PDF .p7m) with the number after the last one in the book, which never comes back; «Sostituisci la copia» (replace the copy) and «Annulla» (cancel) ask for the reason. For the paper minutes book there are «Stampa la pagina» (print the page) and «Segna incollata nel libro» (mark as pasted in the book).

NEW: SENDING THE MINUTES AND THE THIRTY DAYS — The program proposes who receives the minutes: whoever never entered, and whoever was out at the vote on an item, for that item. Each person is a row with the means, the status and «Può impugnare» (may challenge), with the items and the day; «Togli dalla lista» (remove from the list) and «Aggiungi una persona» (add a person) ask for the reason. The thirty days (art. 1137 c. 2 c.c.) count from the resolution for those against and abstaining, from delivery for those absent; for a registered letter in storage from collection, or ten days after the notice if not collected. After «Sostituisci la copia», «Rimanda la copia nuova» (send the new copy again) sends it to whoever had the previous one. «Segna impugnata» (mark as challenged) is a mark on the resolution and stops nothing. The minutes go person by person, never on the notice board.

NEW: THE MINUTES BOOK AND THE REGISTER OF APPOINTMENTS AND DISMISSALS — From the «Azioni» menu of the meetings archive the minutes book opens (art. 1130 n. 7 c.c.): minutes, failures to reach the quorum, without number, and meetings recorded by hand, by date; the staircase and the building have their own book, with their own numbering. The first time it asks where to start: «Continua il libro di carta» (continue the paper book), with the last number, or «Comincia dal n. 1» (start from no. 1). Next to it is the register of appointments and dismissals: the first time it asks for the current appointment; after minutes with an approved appointment the program proposes the row, which you confirm; a wrong row is cancelled with the reason.

NEW: RESOLUTIONS THAT GO BACK INTO THE MANAGEMENT AREA — With the minutes recorded the «Delibere eseguite» step opens: the «Che cosa cambia nel gestionale» (what changes in the management area) summary is all ticked, and nothing changes without «Conferma». The approved financial statement becomes the approved version, with the allocation; the approved budget approves the instalment plan with the resolution (if the meeting changed it, the row stays out and leads to the plan); ratification closes the invoice's tasks; works bring «Crea il piano straordinario» (create the extraordinary plan), which creates the management, its chart of accounts and the item and opens the new plan, and the plan page says how much the plans ask on the resolved fund; the delegation to the administrator carries the ceiling, the scope and the expiry, which «Scegli la delibera» shows; the waiver, the agreement and the rules lead to their record. What is left to do, with a date, becomes an Action inbox task; «Un'altra cosa da fare» (another thing to do) adds what the program cannot see; «Avvisa i condòmini» (notify the owners) prepares the communication as a draft. A rejected resolution is proposed again or closed with the reason; a postponed one goes back into the condominium's memory. «Segna eseguita» (mark as carried out), «Segna impugnata», «Segna annullata dal giudice» (mark as annulled by the court), «Segna revocata» (mark as revoked) and «Elimina» (delete), with the reason, stay in the diary. The dashboard card gives the resolutions to carry out, and the «Lo stato di esecuzione delle delibere» (status of resolutions) print lists them without names.

NEW: MEETINGS ON THE PERSON'S RECORD — On the person's record the «Assemblee» tab says, for each meeting, by what means he or she was convened and when the notice arrived, how he or she was in the room (in person, connected, by proxy, absent), how he or she voted according to the recorded minutes, until when he or she may challenge and the resolutions on his or her matters. Only the studio sees it.

NEW: «METTI A RATE QUESTA SPESA» (PUT THIS EXPENSE IN INSTALMENTS) — The invoice page has the «Le rate» (instalments) box: it says how much of the expense is still to be put in instalments and, with «Metti a rate questa spesa», opens the new plan on the right tab, with the invoice's management and item, or with the invoice in the «Spese fuori preventivo» (out-of-budget expenses) cart; the same entry is in the row menu of the invoices list, and the new plan has «Torna alla fattura» (back to the invoice). On a budget line worth € 0 in the budget, the box says that the expense is not in any instalment plan.

NEW: THE SIX-MONTH WAIVER AT THE MEETING — When the six-month task to act against defaulters is open (from sixty days before the date onwards), «Prepara l'assemblea» proposes the item «Dispensa dall'agire entro sei mesi per i crediti del …» (waiver from acting within six months for the receivables of …), with the number of overdue positions and the amount, without names. The item is no longer proposed once the meeting has resolved on it, approved or rejected; with the approved resolution the «Delibere eseguite» step proposes «Registra la dispensa» (record the waiver). «Da portare in assemblea» is also in the six-month box, in «Rate scadute» (at the top and in the row's «⋯» menu) and in «Recupero dei crediti» (debt recovery).

NEW: THE GUIDES — New guides: meetings, the notice and the meeting file, the room, the minutes, resolutions carried out, the minutes book, the change log, the list of supplier payments. The guides of «Rate scadute», the condominium dashboard, the six-month waivers, debt recovery, condominium and mail settings, invoices and their registration, the instalment plan, the Action inbox, funds, the account statement, receipts and the financial statement say how the chosen resolution, the memo and PEC work today. The «i» icons on the meeting pages show the hint at once, on mouse over or on touch.

FIXED: TREASURY AND F24 — In the treasury's suggested actions «Prepara l'F24» (prepare the F24) opens the delegation of the deadline, no longer the list of delegations, and the people with overdue instalments are in a table instead of inside the sentence. The «Da dove viene» (where it comes from) panel is wider, does not put the focus on the first «Vedi i movimenti» (see the transactions) when it opens and does not repeat the type in the account name («Conto corrente», no longer «Conto corrente (conto corrente)»).

FIXED: INVOICES — The invoice page has «Guida» in the header, with the drawer of the invoices guide, which now explains «Paga per l'urgenza» (pay for urgency), «Da portare in assemblea» and «Ratifica» (ratify); the breadcrumb is short as on the other pages, and the ratification buttons are small. In the list «Nota credito» (credit note) and «Pregresso» (prior period) sit next to the number like «Ritenuta» (withholding), «Accredito» (credit) is a badge like «Bonifico» (bank transfer), and the credit note is written «−€ 183,00». «Collega a una fattura» (link to an invoice) uses the program's menu, with entries that wrap instead of being cut off. The invoice accrual box says what it is for and the three choices, each explained inside its button.

FIXED: MAIL ON SHARED HOSTING — On a shared hosting like Altervista the mail guide no longer suggests an external mail server, which is blocked there: it says to download the PDFs and send them from your mail program. When the hosting does not allow running the sendmail program, the sending test says so with a sentence instead of a technical error.

FIXED: THE DOCKER IMAGE — The Docker image moves to PHP 8.4.28, with the security fixes published by PHP on 19/11/2026: if you use it, update the image. In the image a logo or a signature in JPG now uploads (it gave «L'immagine non si apre», the image does not open), and building the image stops if JPG support is missing.
